core_obligations: Record the two Backlund transformations applied successively to the solution and to its two companions, with their parameters, and write the equations they satisfy (proof lines 379-400).

Form the combinations of the transformation equations that eliminate the derivatives of the companions and reduce the system to a finite set of algebraic relations between the trigonometric or hyperbolic functions of the half angles (proof lines 400-520).

Solve the resulting algebraic system for the half angle of the superposed solution, using the identities satisfied by the two parameters, and exhibit the solution as the displayed quotient (proof lines 520-600).

Prove uniqueness of that solution by the same algebraic reduction and verify that the exhibited expression does satisfy the original equation and the two transformation relations (proof lines 600-626).
proof_roadmap: Setting up the two successive transformations and their equations (proof lines 379-400).
Elimination of the companion derivatives and reduction to an algebraic system (proof lines 400-520).
Solution of the system and the displayed formula (proof lines 520-600).
